parsed.note_claim: A herd of 5 elephants in Katarniaghat, Bahraich, UP was caught in river currents near a barrage and rescued by forest officials, not swept from Nepal floods.

parsed.quote: हाथियों का झुंड बैराज के गेट की तरफ जाने के बजाय नदी के किनारे से पानी में होते हुए सुरक्षित जंगल की ओर लौट गया।
parsed.reason: The page describes five elephants reaching the Ghaghra barrage and being driven back to the forest by villagers' shouting, with no swept-away current or forest-official rescue, and it concerns a different barrage and event than the note's Girijapuri/Kaudiyala rescue.
